items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: Louis, Louis really gave me the influence thrust by him being a trumpet, and after I picked it up that I wanted to stick with it.

ctx.x: And, they used, down there, they used to call me "Iron Lung" on account I could last so long. And Louis, Louis really gave me the influence thrust by him being a trumpet, and after I picked it up that I wanted to stick with it.
You know, then I finally met Louis after I got to New York. He came up and did a number with me. That made me, I was sure I guess I'd just better stay here.
